title: Kubeshark: MCP `download_file` writes fetched bytes to an unvalidated destination path (CVE-2026-129235)
description: Kubeshark MCP tool 'download_file' versions from v53.1.0 up to v53.3.0 allow an attacker who can influence MCP tool arguments to write arbitrary files to any writable path on the local filesystem without validation. The tool fetches data from any Hub API endpoint and writes it to a user-supplied destination path without sanitization, enabling arbitrary file write as the MCP user. On default community installs where Hub authentication is disabled, sensitive captured traffic data including credentials can be read and exfiltrated. The issue is fixed in v53.4.0.
